name: No license stated
content:
ur-c states no license.

GDK release 0.78.0 builds ur-c from https://github.com/Blockstream/ur-c/archive/refs/tags/v0.5.0-rc1.tar.gz (sha256 1f8732869c67f235610cc2eff0709a5ea565c4da3107400d6be3ebf40ac2433b, as pinned in GDK's tools/builddeps.sh). That source has no LICENSE or COPYING file, and none of its 50 files (source, headers, README, build files) carries a license, a copyright line or an SPDX identifier. The repository on GitHub has no license file either, and GitHub detects no license for it.

ur-c is written and published by Blockstream, who also publish GDK, the wallet library it is built into. GDK's own LICENSE (MIT, listed under Blockstream GDK) covers GDK's code except where noted; it does not name ur-c. Nothing more is known about its terms.

Source: https://github.com/Blockstream/ur-c
